soldier: The soldier has the back of the head and the pronotum a mixture of yellow and coffee colour, deepening from the back of the head forwards, the frons black; antennae yellow, abdomen and legs white; head and thorax with only a few scattered long hairs, the abdomen slightly more hairy. Head cylindrical, longer than wide, thicker at the posterior end than at the anterior; in dorsal view the posterior margin arcuate, the lateral margins straight but not parallel, gradually converging forwards. From two-eighths of the way from the front of the head, the dorsum and sides towards the front show irregular wrinkles; at one-eighth from the front of the head the dorsum bears two distinct, juxtaposed black tubercles, and further forwards a steep face of nearly 90 degrees descending to the clypeus. Mandibles short, broad and straight, sharp at the tip and slightly curved. The left mandible has two forward-directed teeth before the midpoint, a third marginal tooth of similar size directed inwards behind the midpoint, and further back a smaller fourth marginal tooth; the right mandible has two marginal teeth at the middle, the first larger, both directed inwards. Antennae with 9–10 segments. Pronotum about as wide as the head, not raised, the whole anterior margin concave backwards in an arc, the posterior margin rather straight. Legs short.
